arguments.message: Hi! You can see the split directly in the invoice. Go to Settings → Billing → Invoices, open the invoice you’re looking at, and expand each line item. That will show you the seat charge (how many seats and the per‑seat rate) and any overage charges with the metered quantity. If you’d like a file you can attach to a budget review, download the PDF – it contains the same breakdown. That should give you the split you need for tomorrow’s meeting!
